function: Reason system: power control for over-the-air aggregation of federated gradients is area 7, but the link is single-antenna (scalar gain, p. 4, Eq. 6; p. 7) with no RIS.
notes: Excluded for system (Step 1, code 6). The work passes the earlier checks: it is federated learning over the air (the learned element is the CNN trained across devices on MNIST and CIFAR-10, p. 8, so no_learning does not apply) and it solves the power control of the over-the-air aggregation itself (area 7, pp. 3-7). The power control is a classical optimization (waterfilling-like Algorithms 1 and 2, pp. 6-7). The paper never mentions antennas in its own system: the received signal is scalar, y_t = sum_k h_{k,t} x_{k,t} + n_0 (p. 4, Eq. 6), with i.i.d. Rayleigh gains h_{k,t} ~ CN(0,1) (p. 7), and no RIS or multi-antenna element appears in the system model, Table I (p. 4) or Table II (p. 7). The single-antenna link is therefore inferred from the scalar channel model and not stated in words, so the reviewer should confirm it. Not graded on q1 to q5.
